name: app-order-history-cards-with-primary-and-ghost-buttons
title: Order Cards with Primary and Ghost Buttons
whatItIs: Two white order cards on light grey showing a winter coat with size, price and quantity, an estimated total, and an 'Order Received' pill in solid black on the first and outlined grey on the second, plus a circular icon button.
whatItMeans: The pair demonstrates active and inactive button states clearly, and clean typography keeps it calm.
techniques: Solid versus ghost button to show state
Thumbnail on a pale rounded tile
Divider line separating summary from actions
Circular icon button beside the pill

vocabulary.definition: A button with only an outline.
A card summarising one order item.
Two versions of one component in different states.
